author: gpt-6
plan: A desktop display with a lower bezel and straight stand. All paired corners share radius 3; shared axis x24. Centerline extremes (4,8)-(44,40).
construction_references: Lucide monitor original and atomic-debug: four tangent quarter-circle corners, centered support, and horizontal foot. Source-specific bezel and stand preserved.
omissions: No complete defining component omitted. Geometry and relative proportions recomposed on SOLO48.
visual_review: Inspected at native 48px and enlarged size in light and dark themes. Rounded display corners, a centered support and horizontal foot remain balanced and clear. Source-specific lower bezel and stand shape retained.
keyshape_reason: The composition is wider than tall; the 44 by 36 visible envelope preserves that proportion.
